sentences.text: Good morning. Could I have a cup of tea, please?
sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: Chào buổi sáng. Cho tôi một tách trà nhé?

sentences.text: Of course. Would you like anything to eat?
sentences.speaker: Ryan
sentences.translation: Tất nhiên rồi. Bạn có muốn ăn gì không?

sentences.text: Yes, a sandwich would be lovely.
sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: Có, một chiếc bánh mì kẹp thì thật tuyệt.
